Trying to choose between Paros, Naxos and Antiparos for your Cyclades holiday? These three neighbours are easy to combine, yet each has its own personality. This 2026 comparison helps you decide which island — or which mix — is right for you, and how to get around once you arrive.

![Aerial view of Paros and Antiparos with the narrow sea channel between them.](/media/2026/06/paros-antiparos-islands.png.webp)Aerial view of Paros and Antiparos with the narrow sea channel between them.

## Is Paros Worth Visiting?

Absolutely. Paros offers the classic Cycladic experience — whitewashed villages, superb beaches and great food — with fewer crowds than Mykonos and a more accessible price point than Santorini. It is the ideal base for exploring the central Aegean, and its central location makes island hopping a breeze.

## Quick Comparison at a Glance

| Island | Best for | Vibe | Beaches | Nightlife |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Парос** | All-rounders, first-timers | Lively but balanced | Excellent & varied | Good (Naoussa) |
| **Naxos** | Families, foodies, hikers | Authentic & spacious | Huge sandy beaches | Relaxed |
| **Антипарос** | Peace, couples, nature | Tiny & laid-back | Quiet & unspoiled | Low-key & cool |

## Paros: Best for All-Round Cyclades Magic

Paros strikes the perfect balance of beaches, nightlife, culture and convenience. Naoussa delivers style and energy, Parikia brings history and ferries, and Golden Beach is a windsurfing paradise. With excellent transport links and a wide choice of [арендовать машину на Паросе](https://antiparosrentacar.com/ru/%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%b5%d0%bd%d0%b4%d0%b0-%d0%b0%d0%b2%d1%82%d0%be%d0%bc%d0%be%d0%b1%d0%b8%d0%bb%d0%b5%d0%b9-%d0%b2-%d0%bf%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%be%d1%81%d0%b5/) options, it suits couples, families and groups alike. See the [ultimate Paros travel guide](https://antiparosrentacar.com/ru/%d0%bf%d0%be%d0%bb%d0%bd%d1%8b%d0%b9-%d0%bf%d1%83%d1%82%d0%b5%d0%b2%d0%be%d0%b4%d0%b8%d1%82%d0%b5%d0%bb%d1%8c-%d0%bf%d0%be-%d0%bf%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%be%d1%81%d1%83-%d0%b3%d1%80%d0%b5%d1%86%d0%b8%d1%8f/) for a full itinerary.

## Naxos: Best for Families, Foodies and Hikers

The largest Cycladic island, Naxos is greener and more self-sufficient, with vast sandy beaches like Plaka and Agios Prokopios, mountain villages, ancient ruins and a celebrated food scene. It feels a touch more authentic and is fantastic for families and active travellers. Naxos is only about 30–45 minutes from Paros by ferry.

## Antiparos: Best for Peace and Natural Beauty

Tiny, charming Antiparos is the antidote to busy island life: quiet beaches, a cosy main town, the spectacular Cave of Antiparos, and a cool, low-key crowd. It is just a 7-minute car-ferry from Pounta on Paros, making it an easy day trip or a blissful base. Explore our [Antiparos island guide](https://antiparosrentacar.com/ru/%d0%be%d1%81%d1%82%d1%80%d0%be%d0%b2-%d0%b0%d0%bd%d1%82%d0%b8%d0%bf%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%be%d1%81/) и [Прокат автомобилей на Антипаросе](https://antiparosrentacar.com/ru/%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%b5%d0%bd%d0%b4%d0%be%d0%b2%d0%b0%d1%82%d1%8c-%d0%bc%d0%b0%d1%88%d0%b8%d0%bd%d1%83-%d0%b0%d0%bd%d1%82%d0%b8%d0%bf%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%be%d1%81-%d0%b0%d0%b3%d0%b3%d0%b5%d0%bb%d0%be%d1%81/) to plan it.

## Island Hopping Between Them

The three islands form a perfect mini-cluster. Frequent ferries link Paros and Naxos (about 30–45 minutes), while the Pounta–Antiparos car ferry runs all day in just 7 minutes. You can comfortably base yourself in Paros and day-trip to both. For arrivals from the mainland, see [how to get to Paros](https://antiparosrentacar.com/ru/how-to-get-to-paros-ferries-flights-airport/) and our [Прокат автомобилей в Пирее](https://antiparosrentacar.com/ru/%d0%bf%d0%b8%d1%80%d0%b5%d0%b9-%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%b5%d0%bd%d0%b4%d0%b0-%d0%b0%d0%b2%d1%82%d0%be%d0%bc%d0%be%d0%b1%d0%b8%d0%bb%d0%b5%d0%b9/) service.

## Getting Around Each Island

All three islands reward you for having your own wheels — beaches and villages are spread out and bus networks are limited. A rental car (or an [Atv](https://antiparosrentacar.com/ru/%d0%ba%d0%b2%d0%b0%d0%b4%d1%80%d0%be%d1%86%d0%b8%d0%ba%d0%bb%d1%8b-%d0%b0%d0%bd%d1%82%d0%b8%d0%bf%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%be%d1%81/) / [скутер](https://antiparosrentacar.com/ru/%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%b5%d0%bd%d0%b4%d0%b0-%d1%81%d0%ba%d1%83%d1%82%d0%b5%d1%80%d0%be%d0%b2-%d0%bd%d0%b0-%d0%b0%d0%bd%d1%82%d0%b8%d0%bf%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%be%d1%81%d0%b5/) for shorter trips) is the best way to explore. Browse the [автопарк](https://antiparosrentacar.com/ru/%d0%b0%d0%b2%d1%82%d0%be%d0%bf%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%ba/) to find your ideal vehicle.

## The Verdict

Choose **Парос** for the best all-round mix, **Naxos** for families and food, and **Антипарос** for peace and nature. Better still, combine all three — base in Paros, and day-trip to the others. Whichever you pick, a rental car makes everything easier. Still deciding where to go this year? Read [why you should choose Paros or Antiparos](https://antiparosrentacar.com/ru/%d0%b7%d0%b5%d0%bc%d0%bb%d0%b5%d1%82%d1%80%d1%8f%d1%81%d0%b5%d0%bd%d0%b8%d1%8f-%d0%bd%d0%b0-%d1%81%d0%b0%d0%bd%d1%82%d0%be%d1%80%d0%b8%d0%bd%d0%b8-%d0%bf%d0%be%d1%87%d0%b5%d0%bc%d1%83-%d0%b2%d0%b0/).

## Часто задаваемые вопросы

**Is Paros or Naxos better?**

It depends on your style. Paros is livelier with great nightlife and varied beaches, while Naxos is larger, greener and more family-oriented with huge sandy beaches and a strong food scene. Many travellers visit both, since they are only 30 to 45 minutes apart by ferry.

**Is Antiparos worth visiting?**

Yes, especially if you want peace and natural beauty. Antiparos has quiet beaches, a charming town and the famous Cave of Antiparos, and it is just a 7-minute ferry from Paros, making it an easy day trip.

**Can you do Paros, Naxos and Antiparos in one trip?**

Easily. Base yourself in Paros and day-trip to Antiparos (7-minute ferry) and Naxos (30 to 45 minutes by ferry). A rental car makes exploring each island far simpler.

**Which island is best for families?**

Naxos is excellent for families thanks to its long shallow beaches and space, but Paros is also very family-friendly with beaches like Santa Maria and easy distances, especially with a rental car.

**How do you get from Paros to Antiparos?**

Drive or take the bus to Pounta on the west coast of Paros, then board the small car ferry for the 7-minute crossing to Antiparos. It runs frequently throughout the day in summer.
